tools.name: get_programs
tools.description: Every US GLP-1 telehealth program GLP Chart rates, cheapest first, with its verified total monthly cost, its score and its lock-in terms. Filter by drug, US state or price ceiling.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: The full verified pricing record for one GLP Chart program: total monthly cost, what it includes, per-drug prices, the live first-month deal, lock-in terms and the What you get facts.

tools.name: cheapest
tools.description: The cheapest verified way to get a GLP-1 in a given US state, optionally for one drug and on a cash or insured basis. Returns the winner and the next two cheapest.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Whether a named US insurer covers a named GLP-1, with the criteria and the payer policy document each answer comes from. Reference information, never a guarantee of coverage.

tools.name: index
tools.description: One monthly release of the GLP-1 Cash Price Index: the cheapest verified compounded semaglutide route, the cheapest verified branded route, the gap between those two, the median all-in price, and the release's own citation string.

tools.name: fair_price
tools.description: The GLP Chart fair cash price, published monthly: for each GLP-1 drug, form and dose (Wegovy pill and pen, Ozempic, Zepbound vials and pens, Mounjaro, Foundayo, compounded semaglutide and compounded tirzepatide), what the middle seller charges each month in cash with fees included, plus the cheapest
